blueprint.wandscape.build:clear_and_buil.zh_cn: 先清除边界 AABB 内非图案方块，再调用 build:place_structure 放置图案方块。clear_offsets 由 EnqueueHelper 预计算为边界体积减去图案偏移。
blueprint.wandscape.build:clear_and_buil.en_us: First clears non-pattern blocks within the boundary AABB, then calls build:place_structure to place pattern blocks. clear_offsets is pre-computed by EnqueueHelper as boundary volume minus pattern offsets.

blueprint.wandscape.build:demolish_struc.zh_cn: 移除建筑的全部图案方块并发出 demolish_complete 事件。
blueprint.wandscape.build:demolish_struc.en_us: Remove all pattern blocks of a building and emit demolish_complete event.

blueprint.wandscape.build:place_structur.zh_cn: 遍历建筑图案偏移，从 block_mapping 放置每个方块。完成时发出 build_complete 事件。
blueprint.wandscape.build:place_structur.en_us: Iterate over building pattern offsets, placing each block from block_mapping. Emits build_complete event when done.

blueprint.wandscape.node:gather.desc.zh_cn: NPC 站在节点建筑旁引导施法。完成后元素直接注入魔法小镇仓库。引导刻数与魔力消耗可按建筑配置。
blueprint.wandscape.node:gather.desc.en_us: NPC stands beside a node building and channels. On completion, elements are injected directly into the town warehouse. Channel ticks and mana cost are configurable per building.

blueprint.wandscape.production:craft.des.zh_cn: NPC 在合成站引导施法，从元素制作法杖/权杖等物品。
blueprint.wandscape.production:craft.des.en_us: NPC channels at the crafting station to create wands, scepters or potions from elements.

blueprint.wandscape.production:craft_spe.zh_cn: NPC 在魔法工坊引导施法，从元素合成魔法卷轴。
blueprint.wandscape.production:craft_spe.en_us: NPC channels at the magic station to synthesize spell scrolls from elements.

blueprint.wandscape.production:decompose.zh_cn: NPC 在工作站引导施法，将物品分解为元素成分。
blueprint.wandscape.production:decompose.en_us: NPC channels at the workstation to break down items into their elemental components.

blueprint.wandscape.production:synthesiz.zh_cn: NPC 在工作站引导施法，从元素合成物品。
blueprint.wandscape.production:synthesiz.en_us: NPC channels at the workstation to synthesize items from elements.

blueprint.wandscape.road:build_segment.d.zh_cn: 沿预生成的路径段铺设道路方块。方块以运行时参数注入。
blueprint.wandscape.road:build_segment.d.en_us: Places road tiles along a pre-generated path segment. Tiles are injected as runtime param.

blueprint.wandscape.terrain:fill_box.des.zh_cn: 用预设方块填充 3D 盒状区域。方块以运行时参数注入。
blueprint.wandscape.terrain:fill_box.des.en_us: Fills a 3D box region with the preset block. Tiles are injected as runtime param.

blueprint.wandscape.terrain:flatten.desc.zh_cn: 平整矩形地形：破坏目标高度以上的方块，用参考方块填补下方。
blueprint.wandscape.terrain:flatten.desc.en_us: Flattens terrain within a rectangle: breaks blocks above target height, fills with reference block below.
